biographical_milestones.event: Dramatic Escape from Boer POW Camp
biographical_milestones.historical_context: Escaped prison camp in Pretoria, becoming national war hero.

biographical_milestones.event: Appointed Wartime Prime Minister of the United Kingdom
biographical_milestones.historical_context: Assumed leadership of coalition government facing Battle of Britain.
Conservative Party defeated in landslide by Labour.

biographical_milestones.event: Demise and State Funeral at Blenheim
biographical_milestones.historical_context: Passed away following severe stroke at age 90.
